CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  March 25, 2025

 The audio recording of the meeting is available here: DRB Meeting – March 25, 2025 (Audio)

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:00 P.M. in Conference Room A of Alhambra City Hall.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Anki Udani, Chairman; Nora Hernandez, Vice Chairman; Michael
  Daninger; Stanley Tsai; Jennifer Ng

  Absent:  Eric Martinez, City Architect Representative

  Staff Present: Steve Kuchenski, Secretary/City Architect

C.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – March 11, 2025
  • Request: This is a request for the Design Review Board to approve
  the Minutes of the March 11, 2025, Regular Meeting of the Design
  Review Board.
  • Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve
  as submitted the Minutes of the March 11, 2025, Regular Meeting of
  the Design Review Board.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 1.
  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Board Member Ng.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

D.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-24-109
  • 321 North Atlantic Boulevard
  • Applicant: Thomas Breazeal

  1
  03/25/2025
   •  Request: This is an application for new exterior remodel, front porch
  redesign, and new site fence on an existing 2-story single-family
  residence proposed to be converted into a duplex.
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS - The
  proposed project is approved with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1) The applicant to either update the color of the proposed site fence
  to ‘white’ to match other railing on the project, or revise the
  material to match the front porch railing in material and color.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) The proposed railing and any existing railings to be painted a
  consistent color throughout the project. Color is to be reviewed
  and approved by City Staff.
  2) Proposed elevations to be corrected to accurately depict the
  proposed window mullion pattern shown on the material board.
  3) Existing elevations to be corrected to accurately show window
  operations to remain, such as casement windows.
  4) Front porch columns should maintain a tapered / battened style
  column, with an optional brick face.
  5) The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for City
  Architect to verify and approve.

  •  Moved by Board Member Hernandez, Seconded by Board Member
  Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

AGENDA

AGENDA
ITEM 4:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB- 24-159
  • 17 West Main Street
  • Applicant: Min Kim
  • Request: This is an application for a new wall-mounted sign for a 1-
  story commercial restaurant business known as ‘Eat’s AYCE Sushi’.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS. The
  proposed project is approved with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) Revise the proposed signage letter colors to show a solid uniform
  color within the word ‘EAT’S’, such as making all the letters of the
  word a ‘white’ color.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) Revise the proposed signage letter colors to show a solid
  uniform color within the word ‘EAT’S’, such as making all the
  letters of the word a ‘white’ color.
  2) The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for City
  Architect to verify and approve.

  •  Moved by Board Member Hernandez, Seconded by Board Member
  Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

AGENDA
ITEM 6:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-24-013
  • 422 South 8th Street
  • Applicant: Matthew Jeng & Daisy Villalobos
  • Request: This is an application for a new 1,022 SF detached second
  unit on the second floor and a 227 SF detached 1-car garage on an
  existing residential lot.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS. The
  proposed project is approved with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) Provide a note on the plans that show the proposed windows to
  have window grids permanently applied to the exterior to give the
  appearance of true divided lites. The proposed grid pattern should
  be depicted in the elevations.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) Provide a note on the plans that show the proposed windows to
  have window grids permanently applied to the exterior to give the
  appearance of true divided lites. The proposed grid pattern should
  be depicted in the elevations.
  2) Adjust the height of the proposed exterior light fixtures to comply
  with the building code and to be appropriately elevated. Relocate
  the column mounted light to an alternative location or provide a
  porch ceiling light.
  3) Paint the porch pier/column to match the main house.
  4) The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for City
  Architect to verify and approve.

  •  Moved by Board Member Hernandez, Seconded by Board Member
  Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  4
  03/25/2025
   Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
